title: A private glass, a public death
text: Grant Larceny died after his private toast at 6:49. Botanical cardiac toxin was wiped inside his silver coupe before the cordial was poured. The glass tested clean when unwrapped at 6:40; food, decanter and pour tested clean. The service dome closed at 6:44, its seal remained intact until the witnessed 6:46 pour, and the glass was then watched through the toast. Contamination therefore occurred between 6:40 and 6:44. The missing conservation reference sample contains the same compound. One attending guest acted alone.

title: An evening of unfinished business
text: Preparation linen was stocked in the shared supply room. The conservation cabinet key was available during gala setup. Grant’s naming agreement, outstanding invoices, trust amendments and disputed accession papers were found among his gala documents.

title: Private service / movement statement
text: The Donor Salon camera was disconnected on Grant’s signed order. Staff delivered the clean coupe at 6:40 and sealed its transparent service dome at 6:44. The numbered seal was watched until the 6:46 pour. The glass remained in view through the 6:49 toast. The service log records no substituted glass or broken seal.

title: Installation inspection / S-2
text: The mounting alert closed the Star Bowl alcove at 6:38. The curtain remained locked until 7:00. The installed plinth has no sliding-glass cabinet; the cabinet appears only in the superseded proposal. The gallery outside the curtain remained open.

groups.title: Telephone circuits
groups.findings: Fixed circuits; forwarding disabled. Live two-way audio throughout the inspected interval. Longest silence: 18 seconds. Each terminal is at least 90 seconds on foot from the Donor Salon.

groups.title: Access-control logs
groups.findings: Occupied throughout the inspected interval. Doors closed; no secondary exit. Freight cabin stranded between floors. Object-study service panels retain three blue seals. Interior recordings show no interruption.

groups.title: Audio and video archive
groups.findings: Original live recordings; no splice, loop or gap in the inspected interval. Wide frames include occupants and exits. Technology glove telemetry and show-desk manual-contact logs agree with their room recordings.

archive.note: Participant identities and private conversation contents are redacted from this technical inspection. Automatic presentation files and still-photo timestamps are separate archive items.

title: Two clocks / a contaminated coupe
text: The linen sample and residue inside the coupe contain the same botanical toxin as the missing conservation reference sample. SECURITY timestamps are synchronized. BRASS overlays use the decorative gallery clock, recorded ten minutes fast. At SECURITY 6:39, the gallery clock displayed 6:49. Its setting remained unchanged throughout the gala.
